chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Riab, from Abu Hamza, from Jabir ibn Abdullah who said:

Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Shall I inform you of the best of your men?' We said, 'Yes, O Rasool-Allah!' He said: 'Indeed, among the best of your men is the pious, the pure, the generous in hand, pure in the two sides (mouth and backside), the righteous to his parents, and he does not burden his dependents on others.'

key_terms.النَّقِيَّ الطَّرَفَيْنِ: Pure in the two sides (modest in speech and private parts)

ai.seo_question: What are the key characteristics of the best men according to this hadith from al-Kafi?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, the Prophet (peace be upon him) outlines the moral and social virtues that define the 'best of men,' emphasizing a balance between spiritual piety (Taqi) and social generosity (Samh). The description highlights self-sufficiency in providing for one's family to avoid burdening others, a key aspect of dignity in Shia ethical tradition. This narrative serves as a practical guide for character development, linking inner purity with outward benevolence and filial piety.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Riab, from Abu Hamza, from Jabir Bin Abdullah who said,

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Shall I<sup>saww</sup> inform you with the best of your men?’ We said, ‘Yes, O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>!’ The best of your men is the pious, and the clean, and the forgiving of the hands, clean of the two sides (mouth and backside), the righteous with the parents, and does not leave his dependants to be a burden on) others’.
en.sarwar: 7. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father all from ibn Mahbub from ibn Ri’ab from abu Hamza from Jabir ibn ‘Abd Allah who has said the following: “

The Messenger of Allah (a.s.) once said, ‘Do you want me to tell you about the best men among you?’ We said, ‘Yes, O, Messenger of Allah, do so.’ He said, ‘The best men among you are the pious, clean, of forgiving hands, clean on both ends (tongue and genitals) who is kind to his parents and does not leave out his dependents to (trouble) others.’”
